async def test_remap_updates_mapped_items_and_keeps_unmapped(env: Env) -> None:
    # Legacy items (workflow_id NULL, position = status) created before activation.
    _, legacy_todo = await _make_item(env)
    legacy_ip_key, legacy_ip = await _make_item(env)
    await _move(env, legacy_ip_key, legacy_ip, "in_progress")
    _, legacy_other = await _make_item(env)

    # Item owned by the new workflow with a real current_stage.

    _, owned_unmapped = await _make_item(env)  # stays at 'backlog'

            team_id=env.team,

            actor_tenant_id=env.owner,

    # legacy_todo, legacy_other, legacy_ip, owned -> 4; owned_unmapped untouched.
    assert count == 4

    stages = {
